messages:
rachel: spotting something odd on the latency dashboard: p95 > p99 for endpoint=/v1/embed in the mobile-ios cohort. looks like quantile inversion on small slices.
diego: paste the console query you used?
rachel: ```
select percentile(0.95, duration_ms), percentile(0.99, duration_ms), count(*)
from requests
where endpoint='/v1/embed' and client='mobile-ios' and time >= now() - interval '30 minutes'
```
rachel: sample_count is 16 for that slice, p95=420ms, p99=380ms.
anika: small-sample + rollup codec mismatch usually. are these coming from t-digest rollups or histogram buckets?
telemetry-bot: rollup_meta: method=t_digest, compression=50, rollup_epoch=2026-03-10T12:00:00Z for affected shards.
diego: compression=50 vs our new standard 100. merging tdigest with different compression params can invert quantiles at low counts.
pavel: +1. we should surface rollup_epoch and compression in the rollup headers so the console can detect cross-epoch merges. also add a rollup_variant tag for future normalization.
anika: UX idea: when sample_count < 50 show a tiny warning icon next to percentiles: "Low sample - merged rollup may be unstable" and offer a one-click raw-samples inspector that shows the actual durations.
emma: product: we can't let SLO tiles flip unexpectedly. proposal: keep SLO tiles pinned to the SLO-rollup variant (future stable compression) and only expose raw/legacy views in diagnostic panes. product will approve after backfill impact summary.
diego: telemetry plan: 1) stop-gap - surface rollup headers (compression, epoch, variant) in rollup documents. 2) normalization path - recompute rollups with standard compression and write new rollup_variant='normalized_v1'. 3) UI - show a provenance badge and low-sample warning.
pavel: add an automated check that flags any saved chart where p95 > p99 and sample_count < 100 so we can triage historical artifacts.
antex: (typo)
anika: (ignore)
diego: I'll open telemetry#5012 (add rollup headers + provenance), telemetry#5013 (backfill normalized rollups), console#2210 (low-sample warning + raw inspector), infra#88 (backfill job orchestration).
telemetry-bot: ticket telemetry#5012 created: "rollup headers: compression, rollup_epoch, rollup_variant"
telemetry-bot: ticket console#2210 created: "low-sample warning + raw inspector"
emma: also ask ops to run a targeted backfill for last 30 days on high-traffic endpoints so we can compute delta impact on SLO charts first. product wants a diff report before changing SLO defaults.
pavel: will add a small migration shim so old saved charts default to legacy behavior (preserve old variant) and new charts pick normalized variant. that avoids sudden surprises.
anika: implementation note: raw-inspector should fetch up to 200 recent events and render durations + a simple sparkline. we don't need full traces.
diego: (diego) I'll triage and assign owners. tagging @pavel for migration shim.
telemetry-bot: ops ticket infra#88 created: "orchestrate backfill normalized rollups for priority endpoints"
emma: thanks. once backfill diff is available product will sign off. for now monitor the dashboard and add the warning copy.
rachel: thanks team. will keep an eye and paste examples if more inversion shows up. end of thread.
